_comment: A real 402, captured from https://demo.kaspa-x402.org/exact on 2026-09-03.
The reference implementation's own server, not a fixture written from the spec.
Two things here were not obvious from their documentation and both would have
broken this client against a live vendor: the quote travels in the
PAYMENT-REQUIRED header rather than the body, and the body is a text/plain stub
that parses as JSON but carries no x402Version — so a body-first client reports
'this server speaks v1' about a server that is unambiguously v2.
